evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: The easy access to Large Language Models (LLMs) has made AI-generated texts on the web increasingly ubiquitous, making AI-text detection a crucial task.

evidence.label: 讨论泛化、污染、稳健性或人工核验
evidence.excerpt: Prompts greatly influence the generation process, but existing detectors focus solely on the generated texts --- supervised methods learn from labeled texts only, and zero-shot methods rely on the text's probability distributions --- ignoring the underlying generation process, which limits their robustness in open-world scenarios.
